summary: Official Katni district, Government of India DILRMP, and Madhya Pradesh land-record references were verified. MP Bhulekh/WebGIS did not yield an anonymous parcel response: the legacy route timed out and WebGIS was JS-only/security-notice constrained. No safe parcel ID plus full polygon geometry or CRS was obtained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-9923-katni.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified official Katni pages were retrieved. Katni's district map is a Google embed, not cadastral data. MP Bhulekh legacy GET timed out after 25 seconds; WebGIS direct GET timed out after 20 seconds while the web reader exposed only a JS/security-notice shell. No parcel geometry was obtained.
